title: An L3 bound for the trilinear Hilbert transform

result.label: An L3 bound for the trilinear Hilbert transform
result.statement: Proves that the principal-value trilinear Hilbert transform with shifts x-t, x-2t, x-3t is bounded from L^3( R)^3 to L^1( R). This resolves the L 3 exponent case of the standard conjecture for slopes 1, 2, 3.
